Orientation + mount-point alignment landed in both placers (EurorackPlacer + SeededPlacer, board.rs). ROOT CAUSE found via the Alpha RD901F pot footprint: origin is at pad 1, but the shaft/courtyard-centre is offset +(5.72,2.5)mm — so anchoring the ORIGIN at the cutout put the shaft ~5.7mm off the panel hole (same for jacks in y). FIX: align the mount point (PartFacts.origin_offset ≈ courtyard centre ≈ shaft/barrel) to the cutout — place the footprint origin at cutout - rotate_offset(offset, rot), keep-out re-centred on the cutout. VERIFIED on slew_limiter: RV1/RV2 origins shifted to x=9.9 so shafts land at x=15.2 (panel hole); jacks' y-offset applied so barrels hit the holes. Also added control_rotation (stands a control on end when its through-hole PIN ROW is horizontal — pad_span, not courtyard) + rotate_offset; the Alpha pot's pins are a vertical column so it correctly stays rot=0 (the 'wider than tall' look is the body shape; a pins-down rotation is a possible refinement, noted). 3 new unit tests. NOTE: keepout_at_rot approximates the offset for rot≠0 (fine — controls ~never rotate).
